The '''Z-6 jetpack''' was a model of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] produced by [[Mitrinomon Transports/Legends|Mitrinomon Transports]] and commonly used by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. Many famous Mandalorians used this type of jetpack, including [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and, in a modified version, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Mind the backwash, Solo.|Boba Fett, upon firing a missile|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Jetpack-NEGWT.png|thumb|left|150px|A Z-6 jetpack]]
The Z-6 was a model of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] was manufactured by [[Mitrinomon Transports/Legends|Mitrinomon Transports]]. The jetpack operated by drawing in a mixture of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] and [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] through the [[intake]] system and into miniaturized [[Turbine/Legends|turbines]]. The mixture was then ignited and released in three-[[Standard second|second]] bursts which generated thrust to propel the wearer horizontally or vertically. Course adjustments in flight were achieved through the application of directional [[exhaust nozzle]]s, and a [[Gyroscopic stabilizer|gyro-stabilizer]] was used to provide counterthrust during landing.<ref name="EGWT" />

The Z-6 jetpack weighed about thirty [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and cost three hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase. The pack could carry enough [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] for twenty bursts,<ref name="EGWT" /> and was controlled through a wrist-mounted control panel or through verbal commands that could routed through a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet's]] onboard [[Computer/Legends|computer]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> The Z-6 could lift the wearer and an additional weight of up to a hundred kilograms into the air, and each burst could propel the wearer a hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] horizontally or seventy meters vertically. The jetpack produced a cloud of exhaust during operation, which could be used to mask the movements of the wearer.<ref name="EGWT" />

A [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] could be fitted to the Z-6 jetpack.<ref name="NEGWT" /> The top of the jet pack had a turbo-projected magnetic grappling hook with 20-meter lanyard (replaceable with 100 meters). A winch inside the launcher lifted up to 100 kilograms. The grappling hook unit was replaceable with an anti-vehicle homing missile.

==History==
Both Jango and Boba were thwarted by their jetpacks after sustaining damage in battle: while [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)/Legends|fighting]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Jango crashed after grappling Obi-Wan with a cable when Obi-Wan anchored the tether to a structure on the landing platform. Jango's jetpack detached itself and flew out of control, exploding against a column. His other jetpack also failed him after being damaged by a [[Reek/Legends|reek]] during the [[Petranaki arena|arena]] [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] while combating the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], leaving him without escape before his execution by the Jedi's lightsaber.

Around 1 ABY, the [[Death Watch bunker]] was found on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. Inside, various [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who could get past the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] and Death Watch soldiers could gain access to materials that would allow them to build the jetpack, as well as [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]].

Years later, while battling [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] over the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], Boba Fett's jetpack was activated by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], launching him into the side of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] and into the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]], but it was the only thing that helped him escape soon after.
